_comment: Manoeuvre-token plan P1.4 (docs/2026-09-18_manoeuvre_token_plan.zh.md §4.1, gate T §3.3): the tokenizer + executor trained JOINTLY, one file per segment length segment_s = control_horizon_s (20/30/60/90/120 s; N1 = segment_s / 10 ten-second control segments; the random-anchor future floor = segment_s). Executor recipe = v2's L1c pa (§2.6): simple-v3 base, specific-force+path-angle + first-order-lag, imitation / heading-rate / bank-TV / final-time / endpoint terms off, 60 s history (seq_len 30), anchor floor 59, remaining-path-uniform anchors with half the draws at L-1, 180 epochs without early stopping, selection on the fixed-anchor common-grid ADE (= ADE[0, segment_s]). Arms per segment length: the learned tokenizer at K in {16, 32, 64, 128, 256} (FSQ levels 4/4, 8/4, 4/4/4, 8/4/4, 4/4/4/4) x two seeds; a NO-TOKEN twin (plan_conditioning off, same recipe) x two seeds = gate T(i)'s baseline; the COMMAND-VOCABULARY baseline B (63 rule codes, z = one-hot) x two seeds. File order = queue priority: no-token, K32, K128, command-vocabulary at seed 1337, the same at 2024, then K16 / K64 / K256. ONE development cohort for the whole campaign, written at the strictest contract (120 s at anchor 59) so the segment-length axis is compared on the same train flights. KRDU only, val split; the airport-balanced sampler is not exercised. No records ("predict": false): the readouts (run_ts.py manoeuvre_readout) read the checkpoints.
